description: Use this when someone asks for their rising sign, ascendant or lagna in Vedic astrology, or why their Vedic rising sign differs from a Western app. Returns the Vedic rising sign, its ruler, and the Western rising sign for comparison. Needs the birth time.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: vedic_rising_sign
title: Vedic rising sign (lagna)
